builds.bundle_manifest_note: The runner's local_build_manifest_sha256 identifies the pre-existing uploaded bundle manifest. The variants in this manifest and each operation's executable hash identify the new absolute-coordinate builds.

absolute16-bounded-original.field_contract: field API differences expected only when squat agrees with mainline visible-child fields; ERROR parents have no fields
absolute16-bounded-original.iterator_contract: native preorder; cached variants lazily unpack IDs; attribute walks derive depth from descendant counts; mainline uses its forward cursor
absolute16-bounded-original.cursor_contract: walk-forward uses bulk cursor attributes; cursor-forward measures native navigation
absolute16-bounded-original.workload_order: rotate by batch and every two repeats, retaining both backend orders for each rotation
absolute16-bounded-original.query_engine: slab NFA and structural plans adapted from ../main
absolute16-bounded-original.seek_contract: known differences counted but ignored by user request
